items.text: changed: the cube now sets how the layer in front is heard. With the grid in front, wall is left to right only (Grid space: Wide) and floor adds depth, so the higher rows sit deeper and wetter (Room). With the field in front it is the field's wall or floor as before. The cube is yellow for the grid and green for the field, matching the two layer buttons. The Grid space menu in Sounds still has Off and Deep, and the cube follows it.

changed: the touch hand, the hold hand and the pencil are now always on the left rail. Tap the hand you are on to swap it for the other one; tap the pencil to edit, and again to come back to the last hand.
in full screen, double tap with two fingers to swap between touch and hold.
changed: on a phone, undo and redo now sit to the right of the scenes, robot and dice group, on the same row. The record group has the row below to itself.

fixed: in the zoomed film view the grid lines and marks inside the frame were soft while the lines outside it were crisp. The grid is now drawn at the zoomed size instead of being stretched, so both look the same.

fixed: in the zoomed film view the grid lines stay 1 px all the way through the zoom, in and out. The line width now follows the grid's size on every frame of the morph, so lines no longer start thin, or end thick, while the grid is growing or shrinking.

changed: the message that appears in the top corner no longer sits over anything: it ignores touches, stays for 3.5 seconds at most, and keeps out of the way while a panel is open or in the film view.

changed: the heads-up display no longer drifts sideways while you scroll it. A deliberate sideways flick turns to the next or previous pane (the same swipe Current's sheets use); a slanted scroll, a slider or a pad does not.
changed: the play-line pads (Way, Feel) now only preview while your finger moves, and the line changes when you lift. Sliding across planar and polar no longer makes the whole grid jump.
Mark size, under "Look of the effects" in Dice and air. One slider for how big the marks the sounds leave are (rain, ripples, bloom), remembered separately for a phone, a tablet and a computer.
changed: the heads-up display's close button is a drawn multiply sign (two crossing strokes) instead of a letter.
